title: Airtable webhook stops sending notifications after seven days with no error
symptoms: Notification pings stop exactly one week after the webhook was created
expirationTime on the webhook is in the past
Ping arrives but contains no changed records
cause: Webhooks created with a personal access token or OAuth expire and turn off after 7 days unless refreshed. Pings carry no data, the changes have to be pulled from the payloads endpoint, and payloads are deleted after one week.
fix: Call list webhook payloads on every ping (which also extends the webhook) and run a daily refresh call as a backstop. Store the cursor between calls.
affected: Airtable Web API webhooks created with personal access tokens or OAuth, as of 2026-10
